name: Supplier reliability
prompt: Supplier reliability: reliability score by supplier, average delivery delay by supplier, and the least reliable suppliers.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  supplier AS supplier,
  ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE delay_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC, supplier
LIMIT 10;

copy.title: Delivery delay by supplier
copy.caption: Sakura Precision averages the longest delay at 0.8 days, while Meridian Components and Rhein Metallwerk are on time.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  name AS supplier_name,
  reliability_score AS reliability_score
FROM suppliers
ORDER BY reliability_score DESC, supplier_name ASC
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Supplier reliability scores
copy.caption: Sakura Precision leads at 97.1, while Gulf Plastics trails at 71.9.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  name AS supplier,
  reliability_score AS reliability_score
FROM suppliers
ORDER BY reliability_score ASC, name ASC
LIMIT 10;

copy.title: Lowest reliability scores
copy.caption: Gulf Plastics is least reliable at 71.9, and scores rise steadily to 97.1 for Sakura Precision.
